title: 普通人用 ChatGPT 写文案为什么总是空话

quality_spec.visual_system: dark proof-card tutorial with crisp UI evidence
quality_spec.motion_policy: useful motion only; no shake, no random drift, no Ken Burns as main motion
quality_spec.still_image_policy: split dense images into steps and reveal one point per voice beat
quality_spec.evidence_policy: real UI and output proof first; generated visuals only support explanation
quality_spec.sfx_policy: subtle click, card insert, and marker sweep below narration
quality_spec.render_policy: HyperFrames quality high plus high-bitrate H.264 pass when needed
quality_spec.cover_policy: standalone poster cover, not a random frame grab
quality_spec.frame_review_policy: review first 5 seconds, full contact sheet, and crowded detail frames
quality_spec.runtime_choice: HyperFrames final timeline; Remotion component clips when needed; FFmpeg only for mechanical media
quality_spec.caption_template_plan: mix proof_callout, chapter_card, word_highlight, comparison_label, terminal_code_caption, and final_takeaway
quality_spec.narration_continuity_policy: single continuous root narration audio; visual transitions never restart, mute, fade, or gap voice; max planned transition audio gap 80ms
